dropdown interaction

Motionby @dejvdesign2026-08-28inspora pageoriginal post

What it is

Label-picker dropdown: '+ Label' opens a menu with a search field, checkbox rows of labels with color dots, and a create flow - typing 'design' offers 'Create new label' which opens a color-pick submenu (Coral/Amber/Mint/Azure/Lilac/Rose/Teal); selected labels become chips that animate into the parent row.

Media

Frame-by-frame

0-15%
Row of label chips (Handoff, Motion) + '+ Label' button; dropdown opens below with search input 'Add or find a label...' and checkbox list (Accessibility, Copy, Handoff, Motion, Research, Visual QA) - checked ones ticked.
15-30%
Typing 'design' filters the list empty and shows '+ Create new label: design'.
30-45%
Create flow advances to a color submenu: 'Pick a color' rows with dots (Coral, Amber, Mint, Azure, Lilac, Rose, Teal), hover highlight.
45-60%
Color chosen: 'design' chip materializes in the parent row (pop-in, others shift with layout animation); list now shows design checked.
60-85%
Toggling more checkboxes: chips appear/disappear in the row in real time, unchecked chip exits with fade+shrink.
85-100%
Final state: Accessibility + design checked; dropdown closes on outside click.

trigger
'+ Label' click; type to filter; create flow; checkbox toggles
elements
chip row, dropdown (search, checkbox list, create item, color submenu), label chips
properties

timing
dropdown 180ms ease-out; submenu slide 200ms; chip pop 150ms spring
easing

loop
demo cycles open-create-toggle-close

Build prompt

Build a label-picker. Trigger: '+ Label' ghost button in a row of existing chips (dot + name). Dropdown anchored below-left: 220px, radius 12, border black/8, shadow-lg; opens scale 0.96->1 + fade, origin top, 180ms. Contents: search input (autofocus) filtering a checkbox list live; rows = square checkbox (tick draws via stroke-dashoffset 150ms), color dot, label; row hover black/4. Empty filter shows '+ Create new label: <query>'; choosing it slides a submenu in from the right (200ms): 'Pick a color' list of 7 named colors; picking one commits the new label. Commit/toggle behavior: checked labels render as chips in the parent row instantly - enter = scale 0.5->1 + fade spring 150ms, exit = fade + shrink, siblings reflow with FLIP layout animation. Close on Esc/outside click returns focus to the trigger.
